svg.title: Reactor core — 3D depth-sorted atom, pure SVG SMIL
svg.desc: Animated 3D atom reactor core in pure SVG SMIL with no JavaScript and no CSS: the whole atom tumbles on two axes while three electron shells are recomputed per keyframe from a rotation matrix, each orbit split into near and far halves so the rings pass in front of and behind a nucleus built from thirteen orbiting nucleons; electrons grow and brighten as they swing toward the camera, photons vent from the core, a perspective floor grid rushes past and live telemetry reports core temperature, tumble rate, shell occupancy and depth-sort load. Ray Lin, agentic systems engineer, AI agent infrastructure, Taipei.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: reactor-core --monitor atom-01 --depth-sort 3d --live · the loop's power plant
